source_caption:
Tulsa King (2022) is a crime drama series starring Sylvester Stallone as Dwight “The General” Manfredi, a veteran New York Mafia capo who walks out of prison after 25 years only to discover that the organization he sacrificed his freedom for has changed. Instead of being welcomed back into his old position, Dwight is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma, with orders to establish a new criminal operation.
With no familiar territory and few people he can trust, Dwight begins searching for opportunities in a city completely different from the streets of New York. He uses his experience, confidence, and old-school methods to gather a group of unlikely allies. What starts as a small operation gradually becomes something much bigger, putting Dwight directly in the path of powerful competitors and people who want to stop him.
As Dwight builds his new empire, he also has to deal with the consequences of his past. His loyalty to the Mafia is tested as he discovers that the people who once considered him family may have their own plans for his future. At the same time, his relationships in Tulsa force him to think about the life he has built and the years he can never get back.
The series explores loyalty, family, ambition, power, and the possibility of starting over. Dwight is a man shaped by decades of organized crime, but Tulsa gives him an unexpected chance to create something of his own. The deeper he becomes involved in his new life, however, the harder it becomes to separate his desire for freedom from the criminal world that made him who he is.
What makes Dwight’s story compelling is the contrast between experience and change. He understands how the old Mafia world works, but Tulsa operates by different rules. To survive, he must adapt without completely losing the identity he spent his entire life building.
More than just a story about organized crime, Tulsa King is about a man confronting the time he lost and trying to decide what his future should look like. Dwight may have spent 25 years behind bars, but his biggest challenge begins after he walks free.

source_details.synopsis: Tulsa King is an American comedy and crime drama television series created by Taylor Sheridan for the streaming platform Paramount+. The series stars Sylvester Stallone as Dwight "The General" Manfredi, an American Mafia caporegime who has been recently released from prison in New York and is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma, where he begins to set up a criminal organization. It is Stallone's first leading role in a scripted television series. The series also stars Andrea Savage, Martin Starr, Jay Will, Max Casella, Domenick Lombardozzi, Vincent Piazza, A. C.
